fullPassage: As Kuhn proposed, our propositions about the world are embedded within paradigms, roughly a network of interrelated commitments to a particular theory, a conception of a subject matter, and methodological practices. Thus, when scientists undertake research, they do so from within a specific paradigm. Even the most exacting measurements are only sensible from within that paradigm. For example, a look into a microscope tells you nothing unless you are already informed about the nature of the instrument and what you are supposed to be looking at. Rather, it is a horizontal shift from one 'way of seeing the world' to another. For Kuhn, 'the scientist with a new paradigm sees differently from the way he had seen before.'

det.tip: theory + conception + methodological practices = paradigm의 3요소

questions.passage: As Kuhn proposed, our propositions about the world are embedded within paradigms, roughly a network of interrelated commitments to a particular theory, a conception of a subject matter, and methodological practices. Thus, when scientists undertake research, they do so from within a specific paradigm. Even the most exacting measurements are only sensible from within that paradigm. For example, a look into a microscope tells you nothing unless you are already informed about the nature of the instrument and what you are supposed to be looking at. Rather, it is a horizontal shift from one 'way of seeing the world' to another. For Kuhn, 'the scientist with a new paradigm sees differently from the way he had seen before.'
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과학적 관찰과 연구는 패러다임이라는 틀 안에서만 의미를 갖는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 과학 연구와 관찰은 패러다임 안에서만 의미가 있다: 글의 핵심 요지
❌ ① 과학 발전은 누적적이고 점진적이다: Kuhn은 오히려 이를 부정
❌ ③ 현미경이 과학 혁명의 핵심 도구이다: 예시에 불과
❌ ④ 과학자는 편견 없이 객관적으로 관찰해야 한다: 글의 주장과 반대
det.tip: 요지 = embedded within paradigms + only sensible from within + sees differently
